Dear Ms. Thornton,

Thank you for meeting with us on Tuesday. As promised, I have attached the revised proposal, which reflects the two changes you requested: a shorter discovery phase of three weeks and a fixed fee of $27,500 for the design work.

If the terms look right, Mr. Castillo will send the contract through DocuSign on Friday. We can begin on November 9 once we have the signed copy.

Kind regards,
Evelyn Park
